limits: CFG follows direct branches only; calls and indirect targets are not followed.
Metadata adjacency identifies candidates but does not name a getter/setter unless independent evidence supports it.
Instruction dump capped at 64 linear instructions and CFG capped at 128 instructions/span 0x1000.
